ModMetaData.name: For the Occasion - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for For the Occasion, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Written, never run. The feature files are in Pickle/Features and the companion steps assembly is built from Tests/Pickle/Source against Mod/Assemblies/ForTheOccasion.dll. See TESTING.md at the root of the repository for every scenario, and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is and is not covered.
